# WebWell

> WebWell is a free browser extension for Google Chrome and Brave. It replaces the new tab page with a calm dashboard (clock, a daily focus, tasks, landmark photos and music), adds focus sessions with a timer and sound, can block distracting or adult sites when the user turns that on, and tracks screen time privately on the user's own device. No account, no ads, no tracking, open source (MIT).

WebWell is heading to the Chrome Web Store. Until then it can be installed from GitHub with "Load unpacked" in chrome://extensions or brave://extensions.

Key facts:
- Price: free. There is no paid plan, trial or account.
- Privacy: browsing statistics are stored only in the browser's local storage on the user's device. Nothing is sent to a WebWell server.
- Browsers: Google Chrome and Brave on desktop. Other Chromium browsers may work but are not officially supported. Firefox and Safari are not supported.
- Maker: Adnan, an independent developer. Contact: info.adnanak@gmail.com

## Product

- [WebWell home page](https://webwell.app/): what WebWell does, with a 45-second video tour and screenshots.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://webwell.app/#faq): installation, privacy, blocking, music, supported browsers and offline use.
- [Features: new tab](https://webwell.app/#newtab): clock, daily focus, tasks, quick links and landmark photos that change daily.
- [Features: music](https://webwell.app/#music): Spotify (official embed), SoundCloud, offline rain, noise and wave sounds, lofi radio, and saved songs.
- [Features: focus sessions](https://webwell.app/#focus): a full-screen timer with calming sound; distracting sites are blocked until the session ends.
- [Features: Protect](https://webwell.app/#protect): adult-content filter, short-video blocker, custom block list, mindful pause and parent PIN. All off until the user switches them on.

## Get it

- [Install guide](https://webwell.app/install): a two-minute, step-by-step guide to installing WebWell on Chrome or Brave from GitHub while the Chrome Web Store version is on its way.

## Trust and privacy

- [Privacy policy](https://webwell.app/privacy): exactly what the extension stores on the device, when anything leaves the browser, why each permission is needed, and what this website collects.
